name: high-signal-news
description: High-signal news aggregation and briefing generation for AI, software development, and tech investment

database.description: SQLite database with articles, sources, feed_entries tables

rss_aggregation.description: Feed fetching, content extraction, deduplication pipeline. Supports RSS, ATOM, SCRAPER, GITHUB_TRENDING, and GITHUB_REPO formats.
issues: Content extraction has timeout errors on some articles

content_extraction.description: Jina AI Reader integration for full content extraction with retry logic and rate limiting
improvements: Added retry logic with exponential backoff (max 3 retries)
Increased timeout to 30 seconds for slower sites
Removed source whitelist - now processes ALL pending articles
Improved error categorization (paywalled vs failed vs rss-only)
Browser-based extraction for GitHub repos and JS-heavy sites
Recovered all 4 previously paywalled articles via browser/Jina fallback

browser_extraction.description: Browser-based extraction using agent-browser for JS-heavy sites and GitHub repos
capabilities: GitHub README extraction with specialized regex patterns
Jina AI fallback for rate-limited sites

sources_catalog.description: 30 high-quality sources configured including HN, AI newsletters, dev blogs

cron_jobs.description: Scheduled aggregation runs via systemd timers

experimental_approaches.description: Four experimental newsletter formats for practitioner-focused delivery

approaches.name: Breakthrough Only (A)
approaches.format: Max 5 stories, only genuine breakthroughs/counter-intuitive findings

approaches.name: Synthesis-Based (B)
approaches.format: Cross-domain patterns, not categories (max 2 patterns, 3 stories each)

approaches.name: Action-Oriented (C)
approaches.format: What to DO differently (Do/Stop/Watch format, max 5 actions)

approaches.name: Single Deep Dive (D)
approaches.format: One deep analysis + 2-3 'Also Worth Your Time' links

resolved.resolution: Added SCRAPER, GITHUB_TRENDING, and GITHUB_REPO format support to feed_fetcher.py. Resolves 'Unsupported feed format' errors for anthropic-research, trending-python-ml, and awesome-ml sources.
Improved extraction script with retry logic, rate limiting, and removed source whitelist. Extraction success rate now 93% (54/58 articles).

LLM-based 'Why it matters' generation operational via parallel subagent delegation. 48/58 articles (83%) have content-specific LLM insights. Remaining 10 articles: 4 paywalled, 6 extraction failures (separate infrastructure issue).

Integrated cross-source theme analysis into newsletter generation. Themes now only register when appearing across multiple generalist sources (HN, Lobsters), avoiding tautologies like 'Rust blog has Rust stories = Rust momentum'.
Recovered all 4 previously paywalled articles using improved browser-based extraction. GitHub repos now extract via agent-browser with specialized README parsing; other sites use Jina AI fallback.

next_steps: Validate newsletter quality with human review
Monitor extraction pipeline for new paywalled articles
Consider automated browser extraction for future paywalled content
